\n \n /* BUILD B3.66 — OWN DRAFT ONLY - In connected Mini Draft, Host sees only Team 1 and Guest sees only Team 2. - Opponent roster/picks are removed from the drafting UI. - Your own 8 slots + 1-of-3 choice stage get the available screen space. - Draft status and pool badge report only your own progress. - Spectators and local/shared-device mode retain both rosters. - Existing independent pools, hidden offers, reveal sequence and multiplayer authority are unchanged. */ /* VDS B4.0 — STAGE 1 PERFORMANCE FOUNDATION --------------------------------------------------------------- Scope deliberately limited to rendering/image efficiency: - Players gallery is no longer built while Home is loading. - Ultimate Team collection is not rebuilt while its page is hidden. - Cloud refresh marks heavy pages dirty and renders them on demand. - Player-gallery search is lightly debounced. - Gallery/collection cards use content-visibility for off-screen work. - Non-critical player images use lazy loading + async decoding. - Reveal/editor images are promoted to eager/high priority when needed. - Existing draft, multiplayer, ratings, simulation and visual design logic are unchanged. */ /* B4.0 Stage 4C — recover the last verified room after refresh/crash. */ window.addEventListener("load",()=>{ setTimeout(()=>{ if(!mpChannel)mpTryAutoResume(); },900); });
